endangerment.comment: Arabic, Baharna (abv-abv) = 3 (Wider communication). De facto national working language. Native to Bahrain and Oman, became widespread around 1861 when Bahrain became a protectorate of Britain and under the control of the ruling Al Khalifa dynasty. Used in trade, everyday communication, popular culture, films, plays, and some literature. Also used in sea-faring and agriculture.
